study.purpose: Confirm the frozen H1-H6 candidate on observations that did not exist at preregistration time.
study.evaluation_data_rule: Only candles with open timestamp at or after first_eligible_candle_open_utc affect paper PnL, trades, drawdown, or verdict. Earlier candles are indicator warm-up only.

frozen_candidate.parameter_hash_algorithm: sha256(canonical JSON of strategy_parameters; UTF-8; sort_keys=true; separators=(',', ':'); ensure_ascii=true)

exit.hold_counting: entry_fill_bar_is_bar_1; exit is scheduled after the 20th held bar closes

costs.transition_cost_rule: multiply equity at open by 1 - total_rate_per_side * abs(target_position - previous_position)

pnl.bar_multiplier: (1 + p_prev * (open / prev_close - 1)) * (1 - cost * abs(p - p_prev)) * (1 + p * (close / open - 1))

evaluation.net_return_definition: current paper equity / initial equity - 1 after all costs
evaluation.per_trade_return_definition: exit equity after exit cost / entry equity before entry cost - 1
evaluation.per_trade_sharpe_definition: arithmetic mean of the first 30 closed-trade net returns divided by their sample standard deviation with ddof=1; zero or non-finite standard deviation fails

early_kill_rule.metric: positive drawdown magnitude = 1 - close-marked paper equity / running close-marked high-watermark
early_kill_rule.high_watermark_seed: running close-marked high-watermark is initialized to initial_equity 1.0 before the first eligible candle opens and then updated after each close-marked equity observation
early_kill_rule.comparison: drawdown strictly greater than 25 percent triggers FAIL
early_kill_rule.terminal_open_position_policy: record the marked open position in the terminal snapshot; do not invent a non-preregistered fill

underpowered_rule.condition: fewer than 30 normally closed trades when the deadline is reached
underpowered_rule.deadline_ordering: at the deadline open, first execute an order that was already scheduled by the prior eligible candle; then evaluate trade count and verdict; do not process the close or create signals for a candle opening at or after the deadline
underpowered_rule.terminal_open_position_policy: record the marked open position in the terminal snapshot; do not count an administrative close as a qualifying trade

evaluation.binary_result_scope: A powered test reaching 30 normally closed trades has exactly PASS or FAIL. UNDERPOWERED is a distinct preregistered non-evidentiary terminal status, never an almost-pass.

background_benchmark.name: SOL/USDT buy-and-hold
background_benchmark.entry_price: open of the first eligible candle

operations.data_source: Binance public OHLCV through ccxt; no API keys and no live orders
operations.idempotency: each eligible closed candle is processed at most once; repeated runs do not duplicate decisions, orders, equity points, or trades
operations.historical_revision_policy: previously ledgered eligible OHLCV hashes are immutable; a changed historical row causes a hard failure before state mutation
operations.workflow_concurrency: one non-cancelling run at a time; non-fast-forward pushes fail rather than merge or force-push state

prohibited_actions: changing evaluation thresholds or terminal rules after this preregistration commit
processing a candle opened before 2026-07-25T00:00:00Z as an evaluation observation
manual edits, deletion, reordering, or truncation of state.json, ledger.jsonl, or head.sha256
reading or listing data/holdout from the forward-test runner or workflow
placing live orders or using exchange API credentials
force-pushing or silently resolving a state commit race
restarting the test after PASS, FAIL, or UNDERPOWERED
